rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care for uninsured or underinsured patients at or below 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.

rules.label: Internal Charity Care for outpatient services based on income and family size
rules.quote: Internal charity is not limited to the state of Colorado applicants. Eligibility shall be based solely on the total gross family income adjusted for family size and is only applicable to outpatient services.

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans for patients who qualify cannot be more than four (4) % of the patient's gross monthly income for bills from the hospital.

notes: Assets are not considered for Internal Charity Care.
Hospital Discounted Care follows Colorado Department of Health Care Policy & Financing guidelines.
Patients may be required to apply for Medicaid before receiving charity care.
Charity approval affects accounts within 6 months of application date; discretion may extend review beyond 6 months.
If Medicaid eligibility is established for charity-covered dates, charity adjustments are reversed and services billed to Medicaid.
AccessOne offers 0% interest, no credit reporting, no fees, and combines bills into a single monthly payment.
Internal Charity requires exhaustion of third-party payment sources and settlement of all insurance payers.
Applications require documentation such as pay stubs, bank statements, tax returns, etc.
Patients have 30 calendar days to appeal a charity care denial.
hdc_uninsured_underinsured may leave out a condition: adds Colorado residency requirement
